turns.said: Hello. How do I register for a TIN number with URA?
assistant: To register for a TIN, please visit the official URA web portal, navigate to **eServices** and select **TIN Registration**. You will need to complete the online application form. Are you registering as an individual or an organisation?

turns.said: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
assistant: The standard Value Added Tax (VAT) rate in Uganda is 18%. This is charged on taxable supplies of goods and services.

turns.said: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
assistant:
Omusolo ogw'omuwendo ogwongerwako (V-A-T / omusolo gwa V-A-T / ushuru wa V-A-T) guli ku ebitundu 18 ku buli kikumi (ebitundu 18 ku buli kikumi) (FY2026-27). Omusolo gw'omuwendo ogwongerwako guwoozebwa ku ebitundu 18 ku buli kikumi ku bintu n'obuweereza ebisabibwa omusolo; bizinensi ezoogera omusolo guno zikungaanya okuva ku bakasitoma era ne zigutwalira U-R-A.
Amateeka agagobererwa: Etteeka ly'Omusolo gw'Omugatte ogw'Omugaso
